newsitem.title: EGYPT: European ministers hold Mideast talks in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: European ministers hold Mideast talks in Egypt.

text.p: The foreign ministers of Ireland, the Netherlands and Italy met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Monday for talks aimed at advancing the Middle East peace process.
Mubarak and his Foreign Minister Amr Moussa met Ireland's Dick Spring, Italy's Lamberto Dini and Hans Van Mierlo of the Netherlands at the Ittihadiya presidential palace.

The European troika is on a regional tour to push the stalled peace process and to discuss the appointment of a European Union envoy to the talks. Spring and an EU delegation have also held talks with Syrian and Jordanian leaders.
Last month, the 15-nation EU said it was seeking a larger political role in the peace process, mainly sponsored by the United States.
Arabs have welcomed the European involvement which they see as balancing out a perceived American bias towards Israeli interests.
